name: map_mutates_in_place
description: Task-specific semantic mutant probing whether the hidden suite actually enforces the contract's 'returns a NEW ok Result' wording for map() on an ok result. This mutant mutates self._value in place and returns self instead of constructing a fresh Result, so the original Result object is silently changed as a side effect (aliasing bug: any other reference to the original ok result observes the mapped value too). Every visible/hidden assertion only inspects the RETURNED object's is_ok/unwrap(), never object identity or whether the original Result was left untouched, so this is expected to test whether that specific contract clause is actually graded.
